definitions.explanation: The ability to grasp the meaning, nature, or significance of something.
A sympathetic awareness of another's situation or feelings.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}の{理解|りかい}が{深|ふか}まった。
examples.english: My understanding of this problem deepened.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{説明|せつめい}で{理解|りかい}できた。
examples.english: I was able to understand thanks to the teacher's explanation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{難|むずか}しくて{理解|りかい}できなかった。
examples.english: His talk was difficult and I couldn't understand it.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{文化|ぶんか}を{理解|りかい}するには、{長|なが}い{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes a long time to understand Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {理解|りかい}のある{人|ひと}だ。
examples.notes: {理解|りかい}のある = understanding, sympathetic

examples.japanese: {親|おや}の{理解|りかい}を{得|え}たい。
examples.english: I want to gain my parents' understanding.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}は{私|わたし}の{事情|じじょう}を{理解|りかい}してくれた。
examples.english: My boss was understanding of my situation.

examples.japanese: ご{理解|りかい}とご{協力|きょうりょく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: We ask for your understanding and cooperation.
examples.notes: Polite request commonly used in announcements

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{家族|かぞく}の{理解|りかい}があったからこそ、{夢|ゆめ}を{追|お}い{続|つづ}けることができた。
examples.english: It was precisely because he had his family's understanding that he was able to keep pursuing his dream.

notes:
USAGE: {理解|りかい} can refer to intellectual understanding or to sympathetic appreciation of someone's situation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{理解|りかい}する (to understand)
・{理解|りかい}を{深|ふか}める (to deepen understanding)
・{理解|りかい}を{得|え}る (to gain understanding/approval)
・{理解|りかい}のある (understanding, sympathetic)
・ご{理解|りかい}ください (please understand - polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{分|わ}かる - to understand (casual verb)
・{把握|はあく} - grasp, understanding (formal)
・{納得|なっとく} - acceptance, being convinced
